messages:
ajordan: FYI support ticket #4321 from Moneta — they report a sharp p95 latency increase on chat.generate since last night. Observed ~3x p95 for short conversations. attaching link to logs: https://internal/ti/4321

dchen-sales: Oh no. Moneta is on our growth plan and they're using us in prod for their chat assistant. AM already pinged. Need ETA when we can give them an update. :flag-gb:

mjensen: Can you paste a minimal sample trace or the request IDs? Any obvious error spikes or throttles? Is this only hosted or affecting Dedicated too?

ajordan: Sample req ids: r_9a8f, r_b3c2. Only seeing reports from hosted. No errors in 5xx counts, just high token latencies. Logs show queue_wait_ms jumping.

rpatel: I'm pulling traces now. Initial correlation with rollout r-2026-03-19-21 (routing changes) rolled at ~02:14 UTC. On canary we saw slightly higher batching for 1-2 token prompts. Investigating whether continuous batching thresholds changed.

sara_oncall: Pasted quick flamegraph: queue_wait dominates. GPU busy is normal, CUDA mem ok. Host-level CPU transient ↑ around the same time, but not sustained.

rpatel: quick log snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T02:10:12Z] req=r_9a8f queue_wait_ms=118
[2026-03-19T02:15:01Z] req=r_b3c2 queue_wait_ms=3820
[2026-03-19T02:15:02Z] host=gw-12 queue_depth=24
```

mjensen: That queue_wait delta is concerning. If routing policy allowed more aggressive batching for low-latency tier, it could increase head-of-line blocking for short requests. We need an RCA and a mitigation plan.

dchen-sales: Customer-facing ask: can we commit to a timeline? They want a rollback if no fix in 24h.

rpatel: Immediate next step: roll back routing policy on a small subset (canary) to the previous commit and measure. If that reduces queue_wait for single-token chats, we'll schedule wider rollback.

sara_oncall: I'll set up a short-term alert on queue_wait_ms > 1000 for hosted-chat-prod and add extra sampling for request size distribution.

mjensen: From product side: this becomes a P1 customer-impacting intake. I'll create a backlog ticket with scope options: (A) immediate rollback (hotfix), (B) tune batching thresholds (engineering change), (C) longer-term routing policy complexity reduction (roadmap epic). Need eng estimate for B and C.

rpatel: Agree. Estimated effort: A = 1-2 hrs (testing + deploy), B = ~2-3 days to validate across workloads, C = 2-3 sprints.

dchen-sales: I'll tell Moneta we expect an update in 6 hours and a mitigation plan in 24. Keep me posted.

deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026-03-19-21 rolled at 2026-03-19T02:14Z by @ci-bot — tag: routing-policy-v2 :rocket: 

mjensen: Action items recap:
- @rpatel: run canary rollback, confirm impact (target: within 4h)
- @sara_oncall: add queue_wait alert & extra traces (ongoing)
- @mjensen: open product backlog ticket and set priority, include customer context and proposed options
- @dchen-sales: update customer with the 6h check-in

I'll triage prioritization after initial verification. If rollback fixes it, we'll treat as hotfix and then schedule B on the roadmap.

ajordan: noted. I'll add support logs to ticket #4321 and mark as escalation.

rpatel: starting canary rollback now, will post results.

sara_oncall: monitoring configured, will alert in-channel on any changes. :eyes:

mjensen: Thanks all — pls drop final test numbers here when available.
